ambiguities.text: The testnet 'will be nuked' without specifying when, how, or what warning will be given
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the testnet can be destroyed at any time without notice. Treat all data as ephemeral with no persistence guarantees.

ambiguities.text: No specification of the consensus mechanism or block production parameters for the testnet
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard proof-of-authority or similar testnet consensus with fast block times for rapid testing.

implicit_assumptions.description: The genesis configuration at yolonet.xyz is authentic and not tampered with
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes could join a malicious fork or be eclipsed by connecting to compromised genesis configuration

implicit_assumptions.description: The Ethereum Foundation bootnode will remain operational during the testnet's lifetime
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: New nodes would be unable to join the network if the single bootnode becomes unavailable

implicit_assumptions.description: No production applications or real value will be deployed on this testnet
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users could lose funds or assets when the testnet is destroyed without warning
